purpose: Authoring-language mechanism probe: typed TypeScript object source lowered mechanically into generated UIKO JSONC, then compiled by the real UIKO pipeline.
rules: The TypeScript facade expresses UIKO source concepts but does not implement semantic validation.
The lowerer only transpiles and structurally serializes authored modules/pages.
Generated JSONC must pass through the real UIKO project loader and compiler.
Generated files never count as authored application change under the frozen path policy.
